title: A survey of the Schrödinger problem and some of its connections with optimal transport
comment: To appear in Discrete \& Continuous Dynamical Systems - Series A. Special issue on optimal transport
abstract: This article is aimed at presenting the Schrödinger problem and some of its connections with optimal transport. We hope that it can be used as a basic user's guide to Schrödinger problem. We also give a survey of the related literature. In addition, some new results are proved.
